clauses.reason: The sole paragraph amends section 1(a) of Executive Order 12864 by deleting the number 30 and inserting 37, to provide for up to 37 members of the United States Advisory Council on the National Information Infrastructure. Executive Order 13062 of September 29, 1997 provides in its section 3 that "(d) Executive Order 12864, as amended by Executive Orders 12890, 12921," is revoked, in the list of Executive orders which established committees that have terminated and whose work is completed. That is an express revocation that names this order as an amendment of EO 12864. Its section 7 states "Sec. 7. This order shall be effective September 30, 1997." so the first-end date is 1997-09-30; the exclusive reading (the order ends when that day begins) is not needed because the effective date is stated, not an until-date. EO 12864 section 4(b) as amended by EO 12970 (until 1996-06-01 unless otherwise extended) is a disclosed earlier scheduled sunset of the parent and is not adopted as the end.

research_rationale:
EO 12921 (signed 1994-06-13; 59 FR 30667) was read in full in the held Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12921.txt. It raises the membership limit of the United States Advisory Council on the National Information Infrastructure in section 1(a) of Executive Order 12864 from 30 to 37. The dossier evidence ACT:EO:12921>EO:13062 was re-read against the held EO 13062 text: section 3(d) revokes EO 12864 as amended by EO 12890, EO 12921 and EO 12970, and section 7 gives the express effective date 1997-09-30. EO 12970 (1995-09-14) amends section 4(b) of EO 12864 to run until 1996-06-01 unless otherwise extended. Machine searches read: U.S. Code 0 hits, eCFR 0 hits, Federal Register catalog 2 hits. Under the owner rulings of 2026-10-21 and 2026-10-28 the end is the order that names EO 12921, with the parent’s scheduled sunset disclosed.
